title: Pre-Market Briefing - 2026-10-13
markdown:
## 1. Market Tone
- **Mild risk-off / mixed tape** into the open.
- Confirmed:
  - S&P 500 was roughly flat in one source and slightly down in another; Nasdaq was down; Dow was up (The Motley Fool, StockAnalysis.com).
  - Chip/memory names were under pressure after China CXMT memory-tech progress headlines and Broadcom CEO comments on the AI trade (The Motley Fool, StockAnalysis.com).
  - Banks were trading against a sector sell-off, but several reported earnings before the open (The Motley Fool, StockAnalysis.com).
- Interpretation:
  - The market looks more selective than trendless: AI/chips and banks are the main early movers, with company-specific headlines doing most of the work.

## 2. Macro And Calendar
- Confirmed calendar items today (ET) from StockAnalysis.com:
  - 8:15 AM: ADP Employment Change Weekly
  - 10:00 AM: Existing Home Sales
  - 2:00 PM: Monthly Budget Statement
- Later this week:
  - Wednesday: Core Inflation Rate MoM & YoY, Inflation Rate MoM & YoY
  - Thursday: PPI MoM, Retail Sales MoM, Fed Chair Warsh Speech
- Macro headlines:
  - IMF raised 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1% but warned AI investment collapse could cut global GDP by 1.1% by 2028 (Reuters via StockAnalysis.com).
- Interpretation:
  - Today’s setup may be driven more by earnings and single-stock news, with inflation data later this week keeping rates-sensitive names in play.

## 3. Earnings And Company News
- **Banks reported before the open**:
  - **JPM**: revenue and EPS missed; interest income outlook raised (CNBC/Reuters via StockAnalysis.com).
  - **GS**: beat revenue estimates with $18.68B; equities trading surged 72% (CNBC/Reuters via StockAnalysis.com).
  - **WFC**: beat EPS despite weaker revenue (CNBC/Reuters via StockAnalysis.com).
  - **C**: beat on revenue and EPS (StockAnalysis.com recent earnings list).
- **UNH**: beat EPS, raised 2026 EPS outlook to at least $20.50; shares up premarket (WSJ/CNBC via StockAnalysis.com).
- **JNJ**: beat EPS and revenue; shares down premarket despite higher guidance (Reuters/WSJ via StockAnalysis.com).
- **DPZ**: beat EPS and revenue, but U.S. same-store sales growth slowed sharply (WSJ via StockAnalysis.com).
- **Visa / China**:
  - China central bank cleared **V** to build a domestic card-clearing business after years of delay (The Motley Fool).
- **Atlassian**:
  - Business momentum remains strong: revenue up roughly 30% annually over a decade; cloud revenue up 31%; Rovo AI layer crossed 1M monthly active users last quarter (The Motley Fool).
- **Broadcom / AI trade**:
  - Broadcom CEO called the AI trade a “casino,” and the article framed this as a warning about unrealistic expectations in chip/AI spending (The Motley Fool).
